scope: RPC transport with mocked HTTP responses; actual Umi/Web3.js integration; no wallet signing
checks: 429 respects Retry-After before read retry
date Retry-After and malformed values have safe delays
persistent rate limit stops after three attempts
long Retry-After is retained and never shortened by another click
concurrent reads are queued behind the same rate limit
submission and unknown methods never retry
403 does not retry or claim a rate limit
JSON-RPC 429 is handled even when HTTP succeeds
timeout covers the response body
diagnostics contain methods/status only, never request bodies or endpoint credentials
messages direct an unstarted operation to an available connection check
actual Umi and Web3.js share the transport and preserve rate-limit errors
observed OnFinality HTTP 429 with JSON code -32029 is recognized
HTTP 401 fails through actual Web3.js without retrying and leaves the queue usable
HTTP 500 fails through actual Web3.js without retrying and leaves the queue usable
HTTP 502 fails through actual Web3.js without retrying and leaves the queue usable
HTTP 503 fails through actual Web3.js without retrying and leaves the queue usable
HTTP 200 HTML error page is rejected by actual Umi and does not poison the queue
HTTP 200 authentication error remains a failure and is not retried as congestion
network loss fails once and a later manual request can succeed
already aborted request performs no network call
abort during fetch releases the queue for the next request
timeout before response headers releases the queue
queue time counts against the overall request deadline
diagnostic history is bounded and returned entries cannot mutate it
